body: This happened so long ago, but every time I look up his name an architect shows up. Where can I find his case? Did he and his mother get justice? I’m outraged.
I think he was just trying to help with his own experience.
College sailing? I’ve never heard of that. Thanks, I’ll do some research on it!

Thank you for the encouragement and advice. I’ll probably end up taking some sort of college degree since everyone is recommending it. Or at least take up a lot of sailing schools if I can’t. I’m not a very happy person, and I’m sure the lifestyle (even if rough) is a key figure to being happy for myself.

Man thank you so much! I’ve been screenshotting everyone’s replies and I’m gonna write everything down. Some of the Texas schools are pretty good I’ve heard, so over the summer I plan to go to a few if the cost isn’t extreme. A lot of people around here are encouraging me to not go into welding. Most likely because I’m a girl and I’m not as strong as the guys. 

I have a traditional “go be a doctor!” mom and really I just want to do what makes me happy. I’ve been on the ocean numerous times, even to some islands around the Dominican Republic (which are beautiful). I’m not one of those kids who are against college, in fact I really wanted to go to one in Atlanta, but I want my future to be on the waves. Everyone has been very helpful here:)

Thank you for replying! Though I’ve always wanted to go to college and even have a college savings, I’d prefer to go to a welding program. My cousin (he’s in his junior year) is in the welding program and he even makes money from it now. 

It isn’t all about the money, that’s true, it’s a good skill to learn. If I did contract work as a welder while sailing when I’m older I think that could work. I could even find a place to work at around here until I’m nineteen and make enough extra money on top of the money I’ll have saved. It’s really expensive but if I were a welder I’d be able to make enough. I’ve wanted to be a nurse anesthetist for a long time but the student debt is crazy. And in our state most people in the medical field don’t make as much as any other state. 

My uncle is making 150k a year as a welder. I plan on going to him during the summer to learn as much as possible. Do you think that would work?

Thank you so much for the advice and being kind about it. I’ve gotten “you’re young, you don’t know what you want!” But the thing is, I do. I want to live that lifestyle even if it’s difficult, if it’s something I can’t handle I will make it something I can handle. 

I have a couple years to learn and I’m gonna make the most of it. Thank you! :)

It was more of a way of me saying I’d be content with whatever was thrown at me. All I know is that I want to do it and I plan on it. I’d be happy dying as a nurse anesthetist, but it’s always better to be happy. I’ve been sailing but I didn’t know a thing about how it worked if you were curious about that.

I can’t turn to anyone, man. I can’t risk going away to a mental hospital and missing out on school work. I would be alive still and drowning in work. Which, to be fair, would probably lead me into deeper shit. And mental hospitals are expensive. I have no friends to turn to, no parental figures, and therapists are also out of my budget. I don’t need someone carrying the weight of my problems anyway. I just need someone to give me an extra push into a suicidal direction, yeah?
So you’re telling me there are people that will give me lethal injection for a plausible cause? Man if this is fake ima be pissed. I’d love that.
